description: Product Edit screen gains a 'Variants, price & stock' section: per-variant editable SKU, MRP (₹), selling price (₹) and stock plus a product Status control, saved via the existing POST /admin/variants (passing the variant's EXISTING priceSlabsJson, attributesJson, weightGrams and imageUrl so nothing is wiped), POST /admin/inventory/:variantId/adjust (delta = target - current) and PATCH /admin/products/:id/status. Adds a duplicate-SKU ConflictException in VariantService.upsert so the error is shown instead of a generic 500. Independent of FEAT-001 (no shared files); runs after it only for sequencing.
steps: apps/api/src/modules/catalogue/variant.service.ts: import ConflictException; in upsert, after assertPrices/normaliseSlabs and before any write: const clash = await this.prisma.variant.findUnique({ where: { sku: input.sku }, select: { id: true } }); if (clash && clash.id !== input.id) throw new ConflictException(`SKU "${input.sku}" is already used by another variant`). No other behavior change (variant-slabs.tsx keeps working).

New apps/api/src/modules/catalogue/variant.service.spec.ts (fake-Prisma pattern from product.service.spec.ts): variant.findUnique by sku over an in-memory array, variant.update/create recording data, inventory.create. Tests: create with a SKU already taken -> rejects ConflictException; update id 'v1' to a SKU owned by 'v2' -> ConflictException; update 'v1' keeping its own SKU with priceSlabs [{minQty:5, unitPrice:900}], attributes {Size:'1 kg'}, weightGrams 1000, imageUrl '/uploads/a.jpg' -> resolves and the recorded update data contains priceSlabsJson [{minQty:5,unitPrice:900}], attributesJson {Size:'1 kg'}, weightGrams 1000, imageUrl '/uploads/a.jpg'; slab unitPrice above sellingPrice -> BadRequestException.

New apps/web/src/lib/variant-edit.ts (pure, no React/admin-api import): export interface AdminVariantRow { id; productId; sku; mrp; sellingPrice; attributesJson: Record<string,string> | null; priceSlabsJson: { minQty: number; unitPrice: number }[] | null; weightGrams: number; imageUrl: string | null; inventory: { available: number } | null }; export interface VariantEdit { sku: string; mrp: string; price: string; stock: string }; toRupees(paise) => (paise/100).toFixed(2); toPaise(r) => Math.round(parseFloat(r || '0') * 100); initialEdit(v) => { sku: v.sku, mrp: toRupees(v.mrp), price: toRupees(v.sellingPrice), stock: String(v.inventory?.available ?? 0) }; validateEdits(variants, edits): string | null — per variant: trimmed SKU non-empty and <= 60 chars, MRP and price parse to finite numbers >= 0, toPaise(price) <= toPaise(mrp) ('<sku>: selling price cannot exceed MRP'), stock is a non-negative integer, trimmed SKUs unique within the product ('SKU "X" is used twice'); variantUpsertBody(v, e) => null when trimmed sku === v.sku && toPaise(mrp) === v.mrp && toPaise(price) === v.sellingPrice, else { id: v.id, productId: v.productId, sku: e.sku.trim(), mrp, sellingPrice, attributes: v.attributesJson ?? {}, weightGrams: v.weightGrams, imageUrl: v.imageUrl ?? undefined, priceSlabs: v.priceSlabsJson ?? [] }; stockDelta(v, e) => parseInt(e.stock, 10) - (v.inventory?.available ?? 0).

New apps/web/src/lib/variant-edit.test.ts: toPaise('19.99') === 1999 and toPaise('799.5') === 79950; initialEdit formats rupees and stock; variantUpsertBody returns null for an untouched edit; a price change returns a body that preserves priceSlabs/attributes/weightGrams/imageUrl exactly and converts to paise; null imageUrl -> undefined, null slabs -> []; stockDelta 10 -> 25 = 15 and 10 -> 0 = -10 and missing inventory treated as 0; validateEdits messages for empty SKU, price > MRP, negative/non-integer stock, duplicate SKU, and null for a valid set.

apps/web/src/app/admin/catalogue/product-editor.tsx: add status: 'draft' | 'published' | 'archived' to Detail (adminDetail already returns it). Import from '@/lib/variant-edit'. State: variants: AdminVariantRow[], edits: Record<string, VariantEdit>, status. Extract a load() (useCallback on productId) that Promise.all's `/admin/products/${productId}/detail` and `/admin/products/${productId}/variants`, sets d/images/status/variants/edits(initialEdit); call it from the existing useEffect (keep the cancelled guard semantics).

Same file: render a new
directly after the main prod-grid (before 'Product attributes') titled

Variants, price & stock

: a Status

Same file save(): before any request run validateEdits(variants, edits) and if status === 'published' && variants.length === 0 set the message 'Add a variant before publishing.'; on a validation error setMsg and return. Then, tracking a `step` label for errors: (1) existing PATCH /admin/products/:id (unchanged body), (2) existing PUT images (unchanged), (3) for each variant with a non-null variantUpsertBody: adminFetch('/admin/variants', { method: 'POST', body }), (4) for each variant with stockDelta !== 0: adminFetch(`/admin/inventory/${v.id}/adjust`, { method: 'POST', body: { delta, ref: 'editor-update' } }), (5) if status !== d.status: adminFetch(`/admin/products/${d.id}/status`, { method: 'PATCH', body: { status } }). On success keep the existing message 'Saved. Changes are live on the storefront.' and onSaved(). On error setMsg(`Could not save ${step}: ${message}` + (/slab price/i.test(message) ? ' — lower or re-apply the bulk tiers under Variants & pricing first.' : '') + (earlier steps succeeded ? ' Earlier changes were saved.' : '')). In finally, after any variant/stock/status request was attempted, await load() so variants/edits/current stock reflect the server (prevents a stale delta on the next save). Do NOT change the media picker, file upload, drag-reorder, star/remove image controls, VariantSlabsEditor (variant-slabs.tsx) or UpdateStockModal (page.tsx).

Run all verification commands (one per call). Commit only the changed files by path: git add apps/api/src/modules/catalogue/variant.service.ts apps/api/src/modules/catalogue/variant.service.spec.ts apps/web/src/lib/variant-edit.ts apps/web/src/lib/variant-edit.test.ts apps/web/src/app/admin/catalogue/product-editor.tsx; commit message like 'admin catalogue: edit SKU, MRP, price, stock and status in the product editor (keeps bulk tiers); duplicate SKU -> 409' with a body listing the verification results. Do not push.
acceptance_criteria: The product editor shows a 'Variants, price & stock' section listing every variant with editable SKU, MRP (₹), selling price (₹) and stock, plus a draft/published Status select

Saving a price/SKU change POSTs /admin/variants with the variant's existing priceSlabs, attributes, weightGrams and imageUrl (verified by variant-edit.test.ts), money in integer paise via Math.round(x*100)
Saving a stock change POSTs /admin/inventory/:variantId/adjust with delta = target - current available; unchanged stock sends nothing

Changing status PATCHes /admin/products/:id/status; selling price > MRP, empty/duplicate SKU and invalid stock are blocked client-side with a message; server errors (409 duplicate SKU, slab price above selling price) are shown with the server message
VariantService.upsert throws ConflictException for a SKU owned by another variant; variant.service.spec.ts covers it and passes
Variants & pricing editor, bulk tiers, media picker, image drag-reorder and Update Stock modal are unchanged (files variant-slabs.tsx untouched; page.tsx UpdateStockModal untouched)
